feeds.title: Cardiff City Supporters' Trust
feeds.description: The Trust is a democratic, not-for-profit group of Cardiff City supporters, committed to giving City fans a voice in the decision-making process of the Club, and to strengthening the links between Cardiff City and the community it serves. If you're a Cardiff City fan, joining the Trust is a great way to express your commitment to the Bluebirds.
